Hey everyone! Just ran the numbers on our shared data. Craft kits are really taking off, along with board games and educational toys. Dolls are trending down though, and Lego's still solid but not as hot as expected.
YES on craft kits! Parents are going crazy for anything that keeps kids busy and creative 🎨
Board games makes total sense - everyone's doing game nights now instead of going out
The educational toys spike is fascinating. Wonder if it's the homeschool crowd or just parents being more intentional about learning?
Probably both! I'm seeing lots of "educational but fun" requests lately
Wait, dolls falling? That's wild, thought they were always steady
Same! Maybe kids are just into different types of play right now?
Could be screen competition too. Hard to compete with tablets sometimes
Great insights everyone. Sounds like we're all seeing the shift toward hands-on, family activities. Might be worth planning our spring orders around these trends!
everyone got their personalized recommendations
Just reviewed my recs - looks like craft kits and educational stuff are gonna be my focus! Kids are getting so creative lately 🎨
Same here on both counts. The data's showing some interesting patterns with hands-on learning trending up

Craft kits AND board games for me. Love seeing the crossover between creative and strategic play

Interesting to see the craft kit consensus! Sounds like you're all picking up on the same creative wave
Bring it on - competition makes us all better 😎
Actually makes sense from a market perspective. Parents want screen-free activities that keep kids engaged
